description: This file defines API route handlers for booking classes and trainers in a gym management system using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for creating and cancelling class and trainer bookings, with dependency injections for database sessions and the current user.

methods.name: book_class(payload: ClassBookingCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles booking a class session by creating a new booking or raising an HTTP 400 error upon invalid input.

methods.name: cancel_class(booking_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles cancelling a class booking, with permission checks; raises HTTP 403 if permissions are insufficient.

methods.name: book_trainer(payload: TrainerBookingCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles booking a trainer session, creating trainer bookings or raising an HTTP 400 error on invalid input.

methods.name: cancel_trainer(booking_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles cancelling a trainer booking, with permission checks; raises HTTP 403 if permissions are insufficient.
